name: com.agent-tune/agenttune
description: 12 read-only MCP tools for AI communication rules, instruction linting & 25-model benchmarks.

tools.name: get_free_tools
tools.description: Return the catalog of 8 local window.AgentTuneTools browser instruments (paired with the 2 web generators at /tools/ — 10 free tools total), destination registry, and local JavaScript API documentation. No personal data is accepted. Download the functions to process instructions locally; this call does not run models or install preferences.

tools.name: list_tunings
tools.description: Catalog of all 43 AgentTune personality tuning files (slug, code, name, one-line blurb), optionally filtered by system. Use it to resolve a user's personality type to the right slug before calling get_tuning.

system.description: Optional filter: one of the five personality systems.

tools.name: get_tuning
tools.description: Fetch one tuning file as Markdown with YAML front-matter. The front-matter links to the shared platform registry and installation protocol. structuredContent.body is the preference text; metadata stays separate. Confirmation of saved text is distinct from evaluation of behavior. MIT licensed.

slug.description: Type slug, lowercase. mbti: 4-letter code (intj). enneagram: N-name (5-investigator). disc: letter-name (d-dominance). attachment: style (secure). ocean: dimension-pole (openness-high). Unsure? Call list_tunings.

tools.name: get_test_spec
tools.description: Fetch a complete questionnaire specification for mbti (32 items), enneagram (36), disc (16), attachment (36) or big-five (50). All five are available, with exact instrument/version IDs, response anchors and strict scoring instructions. The first four preserve the legacy AgentTune adaptations; instrument-specific source terms apply. Administer only when requested, keep responses local, preserve ties, and let users review any suggested communication preferences before installation.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: Search the versioned catalog of all 54 platform setup guides, all 36 empirical AI psychology studies (Waves 1–4 + 12 Personality Atlas pages, 2023–2026), all 25 model-family personality profiles (87 primary checkpoints / 93 tested across 6 surveys), and directory hubs (/models/, /research, /guides/, /library/, /tests/, /tools/). Returns canonical URLs, clean Markdown URLs, revisions and evidence status.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Retrieve one page-specific Markdown resource (guide, empirical study including Personality Atlas surveys and Wave 1–4 YAML Agent Decision Contracts, model-family profile, or hub index) by the exact ID from list_resources; includes provenance and evidence status.

tools.name: check_instructions
tools.description: Check instruction text for duplicate lines, absolute rules needing exceptions, safety-override wording, uncertainty suppression, long lines, and brevity vs. exhaustive conflicts using core.check(). Stateless; nothing is stored.

text.description: Custom instructions, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or Soul.md text to check (up to 20,000 chars).

tools.name: convert_instructions
tools.description: Format or merge preference rules into plain chat, ChatGPT, Claude, Project, Meta Muse Soul.md, Claude Code CLAUDE.md, Codex AGENTS.md, or API JSON payload using non-destructive bounded agenttune:preferences markers.

text.description: Instruction rules to format or merge.

existing.description: Optional existing file contents to preserve when merging (not valid for destination "api").

tools.name: build_preferences
tools.description: Compile explicit user preferences (length, tone, format, pushback style, clarifying questions, optional context) into clean Markdown and optionally format/merge for a target destination.

context.description: Optional domain, stack, or role context.

destination.description: Optional destination format (defaults to plain Markdown).

existing.description: Optional existing file contents for bounded merge.

tools.name: get_model_profile
tools.description: Retrieve empirical fresh-chat survey scores (Big Five 10–50 sums, IPIP-HEXACO 1–5 means, MBTI, Enneagram, DISC, Attachment), Shannon entropy consistency, and Track B behavioral checks for any of the 25 tested AI model families.

model.description: Model family slug or name (e.g., claude-opus, gpt-sol, gemini-neon, deepseek-v4, llama-4-maverick).

checkpoint.description: Optional specific checkpoint ID within the family (defaults to latest active checkpoint).

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare Big Five, IPIP-HEXACO Honesty-Humility, MBTI modal & tie rates, Enneagram, DISC, Attachment, answer entropy, and Track B slop rates across 2 to 6 model families.

models.description: List of 2 to 6 model family slugs or names.

tools.name: recommend_rules
tools.description: Return tested behavioral instruction rules, IF/THEN design rules, and backing empirical study citations from AgentTune's Wave 1–4 research briefs for a specific communication or workflow goal.

destination.description: Optional destination format (defaults to plain Markdown).
